column1: # What each refusal predicate of raw/runtime/RawMetalPredicates.h becomes once the planner decides before emission.
# fate: rule (a planner node rule or ladder rung covers it; covered_by names rules of plan_graph.h kRuleNames),
# client / query (validate() answers ClientError / QueryGated; covered_by names plan_validate.h kProblemNames),
# cb-error (the command buffer fails with MTLCommandBufferErrorDomain), gap (Metal allows it and no GPU-side rung exists
# yet: the work left before the slow backend can go), layer (owned below or above the planner: L3 resources, L4
# programs, L6 the Metal API), nil (L6 answers nil at creation, as Metal does for that descriptor), m2v (an m2v object
# reached raw: gone with m2v), growth (a pool grows or the GPU work waits; never a refusal).

column5: note
terms 5 rotation (R1, probe gpu.x1.rotated_target), 3 samples (R3), 6 format 550 over two planes (R2) and planar YCbCr (R4); terms 1, 2, 4 (type, levels, arrays) are L3 layouts from NIL
pool span or header slot: the pool grows (L3), the GPU work waits
a plane of a planar surface as a texture of its own: a plane TIC over the surface's memory
L3 gives such a surface a conforming pool image; the planner's shadow.refresh then fills it on the copy engine before each pass that samples it
rows past the surface's allocation: newTextureWithDescriptor:iosurface:plane: answers nil
a base off a page: a pool image L3 makes, filled by shadow.refresh
the kernel refused the import or the header slot: a resource failure at creation
the 4:4:4 two-plane code texture: copy-engine remaps from its planes when stale

a base 16 but not 32 bytes into the buffer while the device answers 16 (iosurfaceReadOnlyTextureAlignmentBytes held at 16): a pool image L3 makes, filled by shadow.refresh; below the answered alignment it is a client error
bytesPerRow 16 but not 32 apart: as tex.buf.base
memoryless, or past the buffer: newTextureWithDescriptor:offset:bytesPerRow: answers nil
views of another texel size or of a part of a 3D texture: TIC views made at view creation
m2v's own texture
R1 (~1,400 HW Test cbs), R2, R3, R4 as tex.shape

levels, slices and depth planes of the textures the raw path keeps, and levels of format views of mipmapped ones, are attachment targets (raw_attachment_target.h), for attachments and resolves alike; left: a resolve into a texture the raw path does not keep or render, a planar or YCbCr one, or a format with no resolve state, a resolve from a part of a texture, and what Metal's validation refuses (past the texture, a slice of a 3D texture or a plane of an array)
a stored depth/stencil attachment (zetaDescriptor keeps one-sample depth only)
the device answers no for all three at the claimed family
a turned attachment beside one of another rotation or size or a loaded or stored one not turned, a rotation-4 Load, and at encode a state whose turned variant could not be made (PipelineTurnRefused)
an m2v pipeline state
functions from another device's library: with one backend every function is this device's
a state the pack lacks: made at creation (compiler daemon) or the archive-miss error FailOnBinaryArchiveMiss asks for
the record completes before the command buffer's first job runs: the GPU work waits, never the CPU

Counting and Boolean results on the copy engine (raw_visibility.h); accumulated results (MTLVisibilityResultTypeAccumulate): REPORT_SEMAPHORE with reduction ADD (probe gpu.x1.visibility, d17), no planner node yet
an m2v buffer
mirror-clamp-to-edge and opaque borders: an address-lowering program variant (L4)
a cubic vertex sampler, which m2v filters in the shader: a vertex-stage cubic variant (raw records bind every other vertex sampler)
an infinite or NaN depth bias: the state program's viewport Z offset, as m2v's render_state.rs does
an encoder selector raw does not implement: implemented, or failed at creation per Metal
a command buffer selector raw does not implement: as call.inv
depth or stencil of a combined format: copy-engine remap of the aspect
a copy or fill past the buffer
levels, slices and 3D planes: one copy rectangle per layer; texel sizes that differ are client error copy_texel_size
buffer rows into a texture: copy rectangles, one per plane
texture rows into a buffer: as blit.b2t
a whole-texture copy of several levels or slices: one rectangle each
a fillTexture: of a level, slice, view or region the raw path does not draw (level 0, slice 0 of a 2D texture it renders: CLEAR_SURFACE, or clear.twod)
a kernel's buffer, texture or sampler from m2v
a kernel buffer off 16 bytes with no residual word: the binding ABI's residual words for kernels
no pack kernel at the dispatch's shape: a kernel record per shape
a texture sampled through an image of its own; the cropped-surface-view alias case is not tested
a view of another texel size at a kernel's texture slot: a shadow in the kernel's format L3 makes, then compute.shadow_load and compute.shadow_store
dispatchThreads: with an edge threadgroup at the claimed family

predication raw cannot run fails the command buffer, since m2v's encoders take no records (NativeBridgeMetalFrontend.mm withholds supportsCommandBufferJump): a misused record, a loop open where its unit ends, or records in a command buffer with refused work; If/Else/End and loops run on render enable (raw_predication.h, raw_loop_copies.h)
a mipmapped texture made with no chain: every mipmapped texture gets NIL's chain
formats with neither engine nor a pack mip state stay gap mip_format
MTLEvent waits and signals: Wait and Signal nodes (GPU semaphore acquire, release)
copies to or from a planar texture move its planes' bytes: copy.ce per plane, not built
a sampler header under a planar texture's address map
a planar target through its stand-in; sampled and rendered in one command buffer: its codes converted again after the store (edges order it)
a pass raw could not begin: resolve, YCbCr and extended-range targets are nodes with their rule decided before emission
the kernel refused the submission: a commit-time outcome, the command buffer's error (MTLCommandBufferErrorInternal)
a uniform buffer bound off the descriptor base: the record's residual words (E9)
a texture with no header at the draw: every view gets its header slot when made
a state testing depth or stencil the pass lacks; shader-side tests (copyShaderTests) stay the pass's own work
MTLCommandBufferErrorInternal
fetch ladder rung 4 for any geometry; the states with no storage form stay gap fetch_without_storage_form (11 on iOS 27, 53 on iOS 17 per x1-f1)
a fetched colour with neither form stays gap fetch_without_storage_form
